title: Ticket-and-question management screen
summary: Replaces the Tickets tab placeholder with the ticket-and-question management screen: own list first, questions with answered state, take/send/reassign/release, tags by hand, merge, out-of-scope close, undo, the GitHub-comment pickup trigger and the PRD writer on map-done; 32 new tests.

deferred.what: Every load and refresh calls listPickupComments once per open ticket; with the GitHub store that is one gh call per ticket, so a project with many tickets loads the Tickets tab slowly
deferred.why: Needs a project-wide pickup listing in the store, a store contract change outside this story's folder
